completion_decisions: The target package is the Qianjiang four-case problem plus IGA-PSO, not the paper's Greedy, IGA-only or Greedy-PSO comparison baselines.
The paper explicitly withholds its measured and CFD data and no author source was located; the implementation is an independent paper, figure and predecessor reconstruction.
Hashed Fig. 9 yields 522/7585=6.882% feasible candidates, closing against the printed 6.9%; AEH ranks are anchored to 2000-2500 h.
Hashed Fig. 5 yields 49 nonzero normalized direction-speed states and hashed Fig. 2 yields the WD156-3300 power/Ct curves.
A deterministic four-diameter packing produces 16 turbines, closing against Table 2's 15-18 turbine scale without inserting a hidden turbine-count bound.
The target's omitted wake, PSO, operator and economic values are completed from direct predecessors or explicitly declared Table-2-scale assumptions.
All candidate wake coefficients are full-core precomputed; unique IGA layouts and PSO particles are evaluated by one persistent C++ team.
The paper does not state an independent-repeat count; ten declared seeds will characterize stochastic uncertainty without changing paper-native algorithm sizes.
missing_information: private measured one-year mast time series and observation coordinates
private CFD fields, terrain mesh and correction arrays
author source, environment, seeds, initial populations, final layouts and histories
wake diffusion coefficient and DGWM rmin
PSO c1/c2, crossover cut law and mutation granularity

paper.authors: Weicheng Hu and Qingshan Yang and Ziting Yuan and Fucheng Yang
paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization in Complex Terrain Based on CFD and IGA-PSO

paper_source_conflicts: The paper explicitly says the authors do not have permission to share data.
Fig. 2 displays Ct above one while Eqs. 16-18 contain sqrt(1-Ct).
Table 2 and Section 4.2 report case-2 IGA-PSO as 1.3881e5 and 1.3804e5 MWh.
The paper omits kd, rmin, PSO c1/c2, crossover cut law, mutation granularity and every numerical NAV input.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the four paper problems and predecessor-completed IGA-PSO on a versioned figure-derived proxy; not author CFD/data/source/random state or exact numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.authority: target paper and direct IGA predecessor
constraints_and_repair.resolution: all turbine pairs must be at least four rotor diameters apart; infeasible layouts receive feasibility-first ranking and no hidden repair

decision_variables.resolution: IGA selects a variable-size subset of 522 candidate locations; PSO refines two continuous coordinates per IGA-selected turbine within plus/minus one rotor diameter

encoding_and_decoder.authority: target paper plus direct IGA predecessor
encoding_and_decoder.resolution: 522-bit IGA string decoded to candidate indices, followed by a 2N real PSO vector

initialization.authority: direct IGA predecessor plus target PSO description
initialization.resolution: one uniform Bernoulli assignment probability per IGA individual; PSO particle zero is the exact IGA optimum and others are independently perturbed inside plus/minus D

metrics_and_repeats.authority: target Table 2 plus declared stochastic completion
metrics_and_repeats.resolution: AEP or NAV, turbine count, wake efficiency, feasibility, proposed/physical-unique FES and timing; ten declared independent seeds because target gives no repeat count

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize AEP in cases 1-3 or maximize declared Table-2-scale NAV in case 4

paper_native_cases.resolution: Jensen/AEP, GWM/AEP, DGWM/AEP and Jensen/NAV on one Qianjiang complex-terrain candidate field

parameters.authority: target paper, direct predecessors and declared completions
parameters.resolution: D=156 m, hub=100 m, spacing=4D, IGA 300x1000 Pc=0.9 Pm=0.1-0.2, PSO 100x200 w=0.4-0.9 c1=c2=2 and plus/minus D

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 320400 proposed candidates; physical unique FES counts each per-generation unique IGA mask and each PSO particle call

update_order.resolution: unique parallel IGA evaluation, roulette selection, pair crossover, individual-level variable mutation, elite retention; then PSO velocity, bounded position, parallel evaluation, personal/global best update

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.authority: target Eqs. 14-22, Figs. 2/9 and direct wake predecessors
wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: digitized WD156 power/Ct, candidate AEH speed calibration, Jensen/GWM/DGWM rotor averaging, RSS superposition, AEP and declared NAV completion

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 49 nonzero digitized direction-speed states normalized to probability one and 522 image-derived candidate AEH values
